note: Canonical record of live-verified Canvas behaviors and capabilities. LIVE_CANVAS_PRECEDENT only; do not silently promote to OWNER_POLICY. Verified by GET, not inferred.

weeklyAgendaPages.rule: Weekly agenda pages must exist in the course's '2026-2027 Agenda Pages' module.
weeklyAgendaPages.note: All sampled weekly pages appear in the agenda module with module item IDs, positions, and published=true. Front-page status does not affect module membership.

assignments.rule: Assignments are not currently placed into modules; assignment-group membership alone is sufficient.

observerCapability.piiBoundary: Only schema field names recorded; no observer/student names or emails stored.

conversationCapability.note: Canvas Conversations create API documents attachment_ids; repo transport currently has no Conversation write method. Live attachment behavior cannot be proven without a write test (not performed).
